title: The Doctor Who Sold 10,000 Fake Cancer Diagnoses
hook: He told thousands they had cancer, charged them for chemo, and they never had it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The moral outrage and betrayal of trust triggers immediate sharing; the idea of paying for fake cancer treatment is universally terrifying.

title: The Experiment That Gave 400 Orphans Heroin for Months
hook: They were told it was medicine. They became addicts. The hospital called it research.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines vulnerable children, drug addiction, and institutional betrayal — a viral outrage trifecta.

title: The Pharmaceutical CEO Who Knew the Drug Caused Strokes
hook: Internal emails proved they knew. They sold it for 12 more years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Corporate greed causing preventable deaths is a powerful narrative; leaked emails add undeniable proof.

title: The Suppressed Cure: $2 Honey Stops 100% of Wound Infections
hook: Hospitals threw it out because it costs less than the bandage. Studies proved it works.
why_this_can_go_viral: The contrast between a cheap natural cure and expensive medical products drives curiosity and anger.

title: The Toxic Baby Oil That Gave 1 in 3 Boys Infertility
hook: It was sold for 40 years. The chemical inside did permanent damage to unborn boys.
why_this_can_go_viral: Targets new parents and anyone planning a family — high emotional stakes and personal relevance.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How Tap Water Caused 20% of Autism Cases
hook: The chemical was in drinking water for decades. Officials called it safe. Then the data leaked.
why_this_can_go_viral: Highly controversial and personal for millions of parents; sparks debate and urgent sharing.

title: The FDA-Approved Painkiller That Made People Stop Breathing in Sleep
hook: It was sold as 'safe.' It killed 200,000 people before they pulled it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Connects to the ongoing opioid epidemic; the idea of a 'safe' drug killing silently is terrifying.

title: The Doctor Who Removed 100 Healthy Uteruses for Cash
hook: He told women they had cancer. They didn't. He got a bonus for each organ removed.
why_this_can_go_viral: Violates bodily autonomy and targets women specifically — powerful audience engagement and outrage.

title: The Experiment That Exposed 500 People to Asbestos Without Consent
hook: They sprayed it into rooms where people slept. Then watched them die 20 years later.
why_this_can_go_viral: The slow-motion murder aspect creates horror and fascination; the lack of consent enrages viewers.

title: The Suppressed Cure: $1 Vitamin C Reversed 50% of Sepsis Deaths
hook: Hospitals knew the protocol works. They refused to use it because it costs $1 per dose.
why_this_can_go_viral: The life-or-death stakes and absurd cheapness of the cure drive intense curiosity and anger.

title: The Hospital That Refused to Treat 1,000 Uninsured Patients — Let Them Die
hook: They had a list. Uninsured patients were turned away at the door. The state knew.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into universal fear of medical bankruptcy and death; strong emotional and political appeal.

title: The Toxic Laundry Detergent That Gave 1 in 4 Kids Asthma
hook: It was marketed as 'fresh scent.' That scent was poisoning children's lungs.
why_this_can_go_viral: Every home uses detergent — the personal relevance triggers immediate concern and sharing among parents.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How Carpet Cleaning Chemicals Caused 30% of Parkinson's
hook: The chemical is in every home. The manufacturer knew. They hid it for 30 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Links a common household item to a devastating neurological disease — fear and curiosity drive shares.

title: The Doctor Who Injected 200 Patients with Cow Blood — Called It 'Plasma'
hook: He thought cow blood could replace human blood. 80 patients died. He called it a success.
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurdity and horror of the concept make it highly shareable; almost unbelievable.

title: The Experiment That Gave 100 Prisoners Electrocution 'Therapy'
hook: They were told it would cure their addiction. It gave them seizures. They were paid $1.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines power imbalance, torture, and pseudoscience — strong moral outrage and curiosity.

title: The CEO Who Laughed While Announcing a 4,000% Drug Price Hike
hook: The drug cost $1 to make. He raised it to $750 per pill. And laughed on camera.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visible arrogance and contempt trigger viral anger; very easy to clip and share.

title: The Hospital That Sterilized 500 Poor Women Without Their Knowledge
hook: They signed consent for a hernia surgery. They woke up unable to have children.
why_this_can_go_viral: Reproductive rights violation plus systemic abuse creates explosive emotional response and sharing.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How Air Fresheners Caused 40% of Childhood Asthma Hospitalizations
hook: The fragrance molecules triggered attacks. The company funded studies to prove they were 'safe.'
why_this_can_go_viral: Pervasive household product + child health = viral parental concern and sharing.

title: The Doctor Who Harvested 500 Bones from Dead Patients — Sold Them to Dentists
hook: He removed skulls, femurs, and jaws. The families were never told. The bodies were dumped in trash.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gothic horror-level real crime — the violation of the dead combined with profit creates massive shock value.
